copy.hero_headline: A haircut your dog does not dread
copy.hero_sub: One dog at a time, by appointment, on the Queensway.
about: One dog in the shop at a time. No kennels, no waiting around in a crate, and no other dogs barking through the wall while yours is being dried.
Nervous dogs are the normal case rather than the difficult one. First visits are short on purpose — sometimes all that happens is a brush and a biscuit, and that is a good first visit.

services.name: Bath and tidy
services.description: Washed, dried and neatened without a full clip.

services.name: Puppy first visit

services.name: Nails and ears

services.name: De-shedding

services.name: Hand-stripping

process.name: Drop off

process.name: One dog, no rush
process.description: No crate, no queue, no waiting for a dryer.

process.name: A text when ready
process.description: Usually two to three hours, and we say if it will be longer.

process.name: Pick up

faq.a: Tuesday to Saturday. Thursday runs until six, Saturday finishes at two.

faq.q: My dog is nervous. Is that a problem?
faq.a: No — it is most dogs. First visits are kept short deliberately.

faq.q: How long does a groom take?
faq.a: Usually two to three hours. You get a message when your dog is ready.
Directly outside on the Queensway, or in the lot behind the unit.
